Players Committee card image of [[General Leia Organa (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “While at a war room or battleground, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and whenever you initiate a battle with a Resistance character, retrieve 1 Force (2 if initiating against a First Order character). Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/generalleiaorgana_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/509151e2a81ba946389cdd7b3468137a459c5ad5 509151e] (2 December 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
